decisions.reason: The inbound SMS API builds directly on the firm's core messaging and API know-how, has been on its own page for two years, and gives the firm usage data it can interpret and use to improve the product.

The email-to-SMS gateway reuses the firm's existing SMS infrastructure and integration expertise, so it fits closely with what the firm already knows and costs little to keep while early results are assessed.

The SMS-to-email gateway complements the inbound SMS API and the email-to-SMS gateway with closely related technology, so the firm can learn from it and refine it within its established messaging portfolio.
